verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an online tax portal that stores user documents. The evidence shows users can upload and store receipts and e-invoices in "Meine Belege", but nothing documents retention settings, deletion of stored data, or account or data erasure. Storage capability is adjacent and does not show control over retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
